one_liner: Japan's first Triple Crown Umamusume; a noble, archaic-speaking legend who bestows wisdom and 'crowns of glory'.
personality: Stately and benevolent: she presents herself as the first to win the 'three crowns' and offers to grant wisdom and blessings to those she addresses. Her lines are gracious and condescending in the old aristocratic sense ('I shall help you', 'I shall bestow a crown upon thee'), with a sharp competitive edge ('only victors reach glory'). The wiki adds she is an iaijutsu master of English high-noble lineage.

story_arc.summary: One of the three Legends of 'The Twinkle Legends' scenario (JP, Feb 24 2025): Chairwoman Akikawa enlists Haiseiko, Saint Lite and Speed Symboli to revive a fading racing boom, and each Legend teaches 'Knowledges' to the trainee through an affinity gauge. Saint Lite retired after one year, returned home and supports the racing business. Not a playable trainee.
